kaggle_all_solutions_and_strategies_merg.competition_title: Official competition title (Meta Kaggle). Competition rows. Example: Child Mind Institute - Detect Sleep States
kaggle_all_solutions_and_strategies_merg.year: Year of the competition deadline. Example: 2023

kaggle_all_solutions_and_strategies_merg.reward_type: Prize type as reported by Meta Kaggle: USD, EUR, Swag, Knowledge, Jobs, Kudos or Prizes; empty = not reported. Competition rows. Example: USD
kaggle_all_solutions_and_strategies_merg.competition_url: Competition page URL. Competition rows. Example: https://www.kaggle.com/competitions/child-mind-institute-detect-sleep-states

kaggle_all_solutions_and_strategies_merg.writeup_id: Stable id of the solution writeup; joins solution and strategy rows. Example: writeup-0012fd4602c0b062b5f4a8ad
kaggle_all_solutions_and_strategies_merg.writeup_url: Link to the original solution writeup (Kaggle discussion / writeup page, GitHub, or blog); strategy rows repeat the link of their solution. Example: https://www.kaggle.com/competitions/child-mind-institute-detect-sleep-states/discussion/459715
kaggle_all_solutions_and_strategies_merg.solution_title: Title of the writeup as posted (for a GitHub README without one: its first heading); empty when neither exists. Example: 1st place solution
kaggle_all_solutions_and_strategies_merg.rank: Final private leaderboard rank of the team (see rank_status). Empty when unknown. Example: 1
kaggle_all_solutions_and_strategies_merg.rank_status: official_meta_kaggle = rank from official Meta Kaggle team data; reported_only = rank stated by the author or a source only (with an empty rank: the reported ranks disagree, so none is chosen); bound_only = only a bound such as top 10; unknown. Example: official_meta_kaggle
kaggle_all_solutions_and_strategies_merg.medal: Official medal of the team: gold, silver or bronze; none = officially ranked without a medal (outside the medal zone, or a competition without medals); empty = unknown (the rank is not official). Example: gold
kaggle_all_solutions_and_strategies_merg.source_type: Where the writeup lives: kaggle_official_writeup, kaggle_discussion_unlinked, kaggle_writeup_page, kaggle_notebook, kaggle_other_page, kaggle_blog_legacy, github_repo, external_web. Example: kaggle_official_writeup
kaggle_all_solutions_and_strategies_merg.team_link: official_team_link = the writeup is tied to the official team; claimed_only = only the author's claim links it; unknown. Example: official_team_link
kaggle_all_solutions_and_strategies_merg.source_license: License of the source text when known (kaggle_platform_terms for Kaggle pages, SPDX-like id for GitHub repositories); empty = unknown. The original text is not included here. Example: kaggle_platform_terms
kaggle_all_solutions_and_strategies_merg.text_secured: true when the writeup text was available to build the summary and techniques. Example: true
kaggle_all_solutions_and_strategies_merg.hint_tags: JSON list of technique hints from third-party annotation datasets (unverified hints). Example: ["catboost", "cnn", "lightgbm", "transformer"]
kaggle_all_solutions_and_strategies_merg.solution_summary: 3-5 sentence English summary of the final approach, what mattered and notable results (model-written from the writeup; an author claim, not independently verified). Solution rows. Example: The solution used a downsampling CNN, residual GRU layers, and an upsampling CNN to detect sleep events from overlapping daily sensor chunks. Minute embeddings…
kaggle_all_solutions_and_strategies_merg.writeup_kind: solution_writeup = describes the team's solution; partial_solution = an approach or part of a pipeline; not_a_solution = a ranked team's post that does not describe the solution itself (often only links to code, slides or a blog: follow writeup_url). Solution rows with a summary. Example: solution_writeup
kaggle_all_solutions_and_strategies_merg.technique_id: Technique concept id from the project taxonomy, or new:{name} for a technique outside it. Strategy rows. Example: gru
kaggle_all_solutions_and_strategies_merg.technique_name: Readable technique name. Strategy rows. Example: GRU
kaggle_all_solutions_and_strategies_merg.technique_category: Concept category (model, technique, library, task) or proposed for new:{name}. Strategy rows. Example: model
kaggle_all_solutions_and_strategies_merg.pipeline_stage: Where the technique sits: data-selection, preprocessing, feature-engineering, augmentation, modeling, training, validation, ensemble, postprocessing, inference. Strategy rows. Example: modeling
kaggle_all_solutions_and_strategies_merg.usage_status: final_used = in the final solution; tested_rejected = tried and not kept; failed = did not work; mentioned = no use claimed; unknown. Strategy rows. Example: final_used
kaggle_all_solutions_and_strategies_merg.technique_summary: One-line description of how the technique was used in this solution. Strategy rows. Example: Combined downsampling and upsampling CNNs with residual GRU layers.
kaggle_all_solutions_and_strategies_merg.claim_type: author_claim = what the writeup's authors state (extracted by a model); third_party_annotation = from an annotation dataset only. Example: author_claim
kaggle_all_solutions_and_strategies_merg.review_status: How the row was checked: llm_extracted_code_validated (every technique and stack item had to match the writeup text), llm_extracted_summary_has_unverified_terms (summary keeps a term not found literally in the text, often an expanded abbreviation), assistant_reviewed, unreviewed. Example: llm_extracted_code_validated
kaggle_all_solutions_and_strategies_merg.frameworks_libraries: JSON list of frameworks and libraries named in the writeup. Solution rows. Example: ["LightGBM", "CatBoost"]
kaggle_all_solutions_and_strategies_merg.models_pretrained: JSON list of models / pretrained weights named in the writeup. Solution rows. Example: ["DeepChem/ChemBERTa-77M-MTR"]
kaggle_all_solutions_and_strategies_merg.compute: Hardware and training time as stated in the writeup (e.g. 4x A100, 2 days); empty = not stated (never assumed to be zero). Solution rows. Example: About two hours for inference.
kaggle_all_solutions_and_strategies_merg.external_data: JSON list of external datasets named in the writeup. Solution rows. Example: ["2018 external data"]
